lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Sparse distribution of high-luminance, approximately circular pixel clusters localized on the far-left anterior flank, exhibiting a non-uniform spatial arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with dominant horizontal linear features to form a partial grid-like structure across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Prominent horizontal linear feature running across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive, irregular region of high-luminance pixels localized on the lateral flank anterior to the dorsal fin, indicating significant dermal trauma or loss of standard pigmentation pattern.
